name: Codineer
description: Your local AI coding agent — one binary, zero cloud lock-in. Built in safe Rust, ships as a single binary with no daemon and no cloud dependency. Reads workspace, understands project context, and helps write, refactor, debug, and ship code from the command line.

name: Memocore
description: Agent Universal Memory Layer with persistent, self-healing memory. Built on Graphiti + Neo4j with Claude Code hook integration. Features three loops — Write (conversation → LLM extraction → structured entities → Neo4j), Recall (query → vector search → LLM rerank → inject), Dream (periodic dedup, conflict resolution, stale pruning).

name: Kin Code
description: Lightweight AI coding assistant for your terminal written in Go. Single 10MB binary with zero dependencies. Features MCP support, Soul files for custom AI personas, 10 built-in tools, and Claude login (no API key needed with Free/Pro/Max accounts).

name: Custom Agents
description: Terminal-based AI coding assistant running entirely on your machine with 5 specialized agents (explorer, coder, reviewer, documenter, architect), 35+ built-in tools, and support for any OpenAI-compatible API. Like Claude Code but you own it.

name: Daniel
description: The proactive AI software engineer that lives in your terminal. Navigates directories, executes commands, fixes bugs across multiple files, and manages development lifecycle autonomously.

name: MultiCode
description: Terminal AI coding buddy that reads files, edits code, and runs commands. Free and open-source alternative to Claude Code working with any model via OpenRouter. Sees every file read, edit, and command before execution with autonomous step-by-step processing.

name: memforge
description: Persistent memory MCP server for AI coding agents. Install once, your agents never forget. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf, Aider. Features automatic context loading, decision tracking with reasoning, failure memory, auto-generated rules from patterns, semantic search, web dashboard, and team mode.

name: Waifu Code
description: Open-source anime-style AI terminal coding assistant. Brings a unique aesthetic to terminal-based AI coding assistance.

name: OxShell
description: AI coding assistant for the terminal powered by Cloudflare Workers AI and minimemory, built in Rust. Can read files, write code, run commands, search codebases, execute declarative workflows, and orchestrate multiple agents through natural language.

name: Free Claude Code
description: AI coding assistant for the terminal that works exactly like Claude Code but connects to Groq (free tier), OpenAI, or Google Gemini instead of Anthropic's API. Supports 14+ free models on Groq with generous rate limits.

name: Claude Code Nix
description: Nix flake for Claude Code providing AI coding assistant in your terminal with auto-updated daily builds and reproducible Nix-based installation.

name: Camel Code
description: Terminal AI coding assistant written in OCaml combining functional programming robustness with modern AI capabilities for a unique 'two humps, zero runtime' approach.

name: Mini Codex
description: Terminal coding assistant with workspace-scoped file tools and multi-provider support (Gemini, OpenAI, OpenRouter, xAI). Lightweight alternative for AI-assisted coding.

name: Kempa AI Devbox
description: A self-hosted AI learning and building environment designed for Raspberry Pi, featuring multi-agent workflow for teaching programming and collaborating on projects. Educational IDE environment for learning and building with AI assistance.

name: RewindAI
description: VS Code extension that gives AI coding agents version-controlled memory. Chat, commit, checkout — the agent remembers. Powered by Neo4j knowledge graph and RocketRide AI pipelines with git-integrated context storage where commits carry AI conversation context.

name: Zenith Terminal Buddy
description: An interactive AI-powered pet mascot for VS Code that monitors terminal output to automatically catch and explain errors before you even have to ask. Makes AI assistance fun with a Tamagotchi-like companion supporting Claude, Gemini, and Groq APIs.

name: Codebase Autocomplete Plugin
description: Codebase-aware AI autocomplete plugin for JetBrains IDEs using RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), Groq, and ChromaDB. Provides intelligent code suggestions based on your entire codebase context.

name: Danucode
description: The simplest agent shell for your own models. Backend-agnostic terminal coding agent supporting Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint with minimal configuration and maximum flexibility.

name: Clean Sweep Cortex
description: A terminal-based AI coding agent specifically designed to help with cleaning WordPress malwares. Combines code analysis with security-focused workflows for identifying and removing malicious code.

name: openclaw-workspace-version-control
description: OpenClaw workspace version control - Safe memory management and rollback for AI agents with version-controlled memory system.

name: Trust
description: A shared terminal environment for pair programming with AI agents. Built with Rust, it provides a terminal-based IDE environment for collaborative AI-assisted programming.

name: CodeForge
description: An AI code editor that wraps Claude Code and Codex into a native desktop application with multi-thread sessions, an embedded browser, and a sleek dark UI. Supports running multiple Claude Code/Codex conversations in parallel tabs.

name: Anvil
description: A desktop IDE designed specifically for parallel agent work. It enables isolated worktrees for parallel development without merge conflicts, provides first-class spec support with phase tracking and plan execution, and includes a full IDE environment.

name: Orager
description: Production-grade AI agent runtime and CLI built as the runtime behind Paperclip agents. Features multi-turn tool-calling, persistent memory (3-layer SQLite), multimodal input, multi-agent orchestration, and multi-model routing.

name: Yode
description: Open-source AI coding agent for your terminal built in Rust. Reads, edits, searches, and runs commands from a single conversation with multi-provider support, streaming responses, and automatic context summarization.

name: continuum
description: Async task queue + persistent memory for AI agents that remembers everything, runs tasks while you sleep, and picks up exactly where you left off. Works with Claude Code Remote Control and Claude.ai web with 35+ MCP tools featuring background daemon with structured checkpoints.
